module.purpose: Defines the attendee email template used to send verification codes and render localized HTML and text email payloads.
module.summary: This module models an email message for verifying an attendee account or email address. It extends the shared email base, stores typed verification input, selects localized subject variants based on verification mode, renders the HTML template, and generates a stripped plain-text body. Recipient, sender, application, company, and translation values are assembled into a mailer-compatible payload.
module.businessContext: Supports account and email verification during attendee onboarding and security flows. Failure prevents users from completing verification and accessing scheduling functionality.
